episodes.title: Nuts About You
episodes.summary: Scrat first meets his adorable son Baby Scrat and experiences the pure joy of being a father until the moment when Baby Scrat sees the acorn for the first time.

episodes.title: LoFi Scrat Beats to Sleep/Chill to
episodes.summary: Scrat manages to get the acorn away from his sleeping son, but Baby Scrat cries so loudly that he causes an avalanche.. Scrat does everything he can to get Baby Scrat back to sleep and prevent the avalanche.

episodes.title: X's and Uh-O's
episodes.summary: Scrat demonstrates for Baby Scrat how to plant The Acorn, but Scrat is really the one being taught a lesson.

episodes.title: Nutty Reflections
episodes.summary: Scrat and Baby Scrat pursue after The Acorn into a dark cave, which resembles a creepy funhouse hall of mirrors.

episodes.title: Teeter Toddler
episodes.summary: Thanks to a dodo bird, Scrat and Baby Scrat end up on opposite sides of a log held up by a single branch.

episodes.title: Nut The End
episodes.summary: The Acorn goes flying off a cliff. With it seemingly gone forever, can Scrat and Baby Scrat live in harmony?
